_doc: Cold-gas thruster kit for the MINI EV, modelled on the Tesla Roadster (2nd gen) 'Rocket' trim: 10 SpaceX-style cold-gas thrusters fed from COPV air bottles. All positions/directions are in the CAR BODY FRAME (lattice rest frame: +X right, +Y up, +Z forward, metres, origin on the ground under the car centre). Nozzle order below IS the action-vector order (index 0..9) everywhere: controllers, recordings, trajectories, UI. Thrust acts along -exhaust (the gas leaves along `exhaust`). Throat diameter is primary; thrust and mass flow are derived by the reference model in spec/README.md. `_approx` keys are informative only.

tank._doc: Six Type-IV COPVs on one manifold, treated as a single gas volume. Polytropic blowdown p*V^n = const per unit mass with n between isothermal (1.0) and adiabatic (gamma).

regulator._doc: Feed pressure to every valve: p_c = min(p_set, p_tank - dp_min), never below ambient.

valve._doc: Proportional valves. Commanded opening u_cmd in [0,1] at the control rate; actual opening follows a first-order lag; commands below `deadband` close the valve.

suspension._doc: Heavy-duty rear coil-overs that come with the kit (soft body, src/softbody/actuators.js applyMass): the rear spring rate is the car's (src/car/carPrep.js SPRING.k) times rear_spring_scale, so the rear axle, carrying ~66 % of the loaded car, sags like the front instead of resting on its bump stops. Scale = rear / front corner load at half a burn (365 / 186 kg). The bare car (crash presets) keeps its springs; the flight twin's suspension is its own (spec/vehicle.json).
suspension._arm_doc: Heavy-duty rear control arms (2026-10-21): the give of the rear wheels' control-arm connectors (src/car/carPrep.js SUSP beams, `tear` = stretch at which an arm lets go, before the preset's `joints` factor) times rear_arm_give_scale. With the stiff rear springs the stock rear arms snapped on the `flat` launch when the car leaves the deck (2 arms on the rear left); with x2 they hold. Front arms stay stock.
